scope: CVG-001 fail-fast SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN validation across env and managed-secret startup

criteria.description: Fresh residual evidence identifies that managed/Vault setup-token values can pass shared startup resolution even though the later API helper rejects weak values.
criteria.limitations: Selection is repository-local evidence and does not certify production secret-manager behavior or global readiness.

criteria.description: The existing setup-token validator already defines minimum length, whitespace, distinctness and redaction behavior, and can be extended with a bounded short-period repetition guard without changing token comparison.
criteria.limitations: The new pattern rule must be proven by TDD and must preserve valid operator-generated token compatibility.

criteria.description: The smallest safe implementation is limited to the shared config/startup boundary and setup-token helper/tests, preserving missing-token disabled semantics and the existing installation sentinel.
criteria.limitations: Any schema, provisioning, rotation, MFA, provider or target change requires fresh authority.

criteria.description: The frozen Quality Bar requires intentional RED, direct and managed-secret startup coverage, API regression, static/security quality, coverage, typecheck/build and independent review before bounded closure.
criteria.limitations: All implementation and verification evidence remains open until TDD RED/GREEN and review are complete.

gaps: Intentional RED/GREEN, startup/config regression, quality, independent review and final reconciliation remain open.
Installation sentinel, setup transaction, authentication, MFA, Redis, providers, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP behavior remain out of scope.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation, direct local reconciliation and two independent read-only residual scouts
authority.scope: Repository-local fail-fast validation of the explicit SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN at shared config and managed-secret startup boundaries
authority.decision: Authorize only the strict setup-token validation seam shared by loadApiConfig, Vault-resolved startup and the first-run token helper. Reject short, whitespace-bearing, low-distinctness or obviously short-period repeating configured values without echoing the secret; preserve missing-token disabled semantics, constant-time comparison and existing setup response behavior. Exclude sentinel/schema changes, token rotation, MFA, Redis/distributed state, providers, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing the installation sentinel, setup transaction/schema, token rotation, authentication/MFA/distributed state, providers or any target/production/deployment/release/global parity surface.

next_action: Write and run the intentional RED for weak managed-secret/direct setup-token validation, then implement the smallest shared startup validator. Keep parent CVG-001/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
revalidation_triggers: Changing installation sentinel, setup transaction/schema or provisioning semantics
Changing token rotation, authentication, MFA or distributed-cache policy
Changing providers, target, production, deployment, backup/restore, release or global parity behavior
